Cost is a real open question, not assumed.

aliases: Harvard Undergraduate Ventures-TECH Summer Program (HUVTSP) - discontinued legacy name
organizer: Venture & Tech Summer Program (VTSP), an independent organization
organizer_domain_provenance: vtsp.com is the organizer's own primary domain; organizer's own site states it was 'previously run as the Harvard Undergraduate Ventures-TECH Summer Program... has since evolved into an independent, globally-recognized innovation institution'
citizenship_restrictions: None stated; official admissions page states 'All high school students, along with international equivalents and those taking a gap year before university, are encouraged to apply'
turkey_access_reasoning: Official admissions page explicitly welcomes 'international equivalents' with no citizenship bar and the program runs fully online, removing the travel/visa barrier that limits most US-based options. Condition is cost ($4,750), though need-based/merit aid including full-tuition awards is documented.
age_range_verbatim: 'all high school students' - no numeric age/grade band stated
individual_or_team: team (students work in teams placed at partner startups)
cost_note: Official page: tuition '$4,750 for the full 6-week program' (same for both sessions), plus a non-refundable $35 application fee.
financial_aid_note: Official page: 'need-based and merit-based scholarships, awarded on a case-by-case basis to admitted students, including a limited number of full-tuition awards for exceptional high-need candidates.'
selection_process: Rolling admissions across several rounds; early applicants get priority due to limited spots per the official page.
award_or_output: Placement in a team working directly on a real project at a VC-backed early-stage startup ('Internship Projects At Cutting-Edge VC-Backed Startups'), plus workshops with founders/investors and 1-on-1 mentorship.
duration: 6 weeks per session, two sessions per summer
current_cycle_label: Summer 2026 (Session I: June 8-July 17, 2026; Session II: July 6-August 14, 2026) - both sessions have already run/concluded as of the 2026-08-26 research date; next cycle's Invite-Only round historically opens around November of the preceding year and was not yet confirmed for a 2027 cycle this session

research_notes: CRITICAL PROVIDER/HOST DISTINCTION (contract Part 1 SS8): VTSP is explicitly, by its OWN site's account, no longer affiliated with Harvard - it must never be presented as a Harvard program despite its legacy name (HUVTSP) and Harvard-student founding history. This is one of the few candidates in this whole research pass that is a genuine internship (real placement on a real team at a real operating startup) rather than a mentored-research or coaching product sold as an 'internship' - classified as category=internship accordingly, distinct from Veritas AI (S5B-0004) which uses similar language but is mentored project work, not a placement.
